title: {item:bone_dice}
text:
翻出一副{item:bone_dice}。它不能打，但它是{b}祭品{/b}：骨头做的东西是{faith:brute}最爱的，献祭时信力按稀有度再乘 {faith_offer:brute:bone:multiplier} 倍。

再搜一次。

texts.en:
You dig up some {item:bone_dice}. You can't fight with them, but they're an {b}Offering{/b}: {faith:brute} loves anything made of bone. Offer them and the Faith, already set by Rarity, is multiplied by {faith_offer:brute:bone:multiplier}.

Search again.
